who.value: seller with a running Spotlight campaign

job.value: review, add or remove the listings in the campaign

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Campaign listings', 'Add listings' and the list with clicks and chats per listing make the job clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: 'Add listings' sits at the top and 'Done' is the one filled button at the bottom.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Add listings' and 'Done' are clear, but the bare '×' on each row doesn't say it removes the listing from the campaign rather than dismissing something.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Add/remove decisions are ones the seller can make from the clicks and chats shown.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Only clicks and chats per listing; no extra stats.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything is for managing this campaign's listings.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Rows carry it; the helper line is one sentence.
